instruction: In pylint/checkers/refactoring/refactoring_checker.py, import WarningScope with a new line "from pylint.constants import WarningScope" right after the line "from pylint.checkers.utils import node_frame_class". Then give the stop-iteration-return message definition (R1708) the scope: add the line {"scope": WarningScope.NODE}, as the last element of its tuple, after the string that ends "replaced by a simple return statement", indented like that string.

require.match: replaced by a simple return statement",\n\s+\{"scope": WarningScope\.NODE\},
